title: Explicit Super-Linear Algebra over K[θ1, θ2]: A General Berezinian Correction Formula and Multiplicativity Theorem for Arbitrary Block Size
summary: We study super-matrices $M_{m|n}(R)$ over the rank-two exterior algebra $R=K[θ_1,θ_2]/(θ_1^2,θ_2^2,θ_1θ_2+θ_2θ_1)$, the smallest supercommutative ring on which the Berezinian's odd-by-odd correction term $BD^{-1}C$ need not vanish. We recall that the supertrace satisfies graded cyclicity, $\mathrm{str}(XY)=(-1)^{|X||Y|}\mathrm{str}(YX)$, so $\mathrm{str}([A,B])=0$ for even $A,B$, and that an explicit $1|1$ matrix over $R$ has $BD^{-1}C\neq0$ surviving to second order in the odd generators.
